segments.text: ALmighty and euerlaſtyng god, which haſte geuen vnto vs thy ſeruauntes grace by the confeſſion of a true fayth to acknowlege the glory of the eternal trinitie, and in the power of the diuyne maieſtie to wurſhip the vnitie: we beſeche thee that through the ſtedfaſtnes of this fayth, we may euermore be defended from all aduerſitie: whiche liueſt and reigneſt one God, worlde with out ende.
